scanNote:
10-UNITNING OXIRGI BETI (75-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Stick to the Rules!' va YaShIL yorliqda oq '10'.

CHAP USTUN:
19) 'What would you say to: a young child playing near a pond? a teenager going skiing? a man going bird-watching near a beach? Give advice, as in the example, using MUST or MUSTN'T.' Ko'k qiya: "You mustn't play near the pond."
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Communication: Positive/Negative Agreement'.
20) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and repeat, then use the prompts to act out similar dialogues in pairs.' A: Tomorrow, I have to WASH THE CAR. B: So do I, but I don't have to DO THE GARDENING tomorrow. A: Neither do I. Ko'rsatmalar: wash the car, do the gardening, fix the fence, paint the living room, clean the house, tidy the garage
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Vocabulary Revision Game'.
21) 'In teams, make sentences using words/phrases from the list. Each correct sentence gets one point.' Qiya: put up signs, cleaning products, climb the cliffs, drown, play alone, was trapped, coastguard, release a statement, electric shock, sharp objects
• Katta to'q sariq 'Pronunciation'.
22) a) Kasseta belgisi: "We don't always use the 'strong form' of must/mustn't in sentences. Listen and repeat." Jadval: 'strong form': must /mʌst/, mustn't /mʌsnt/ | '... but in some sentences': You MUST do your best. /məs/; You MUST always try hard. /məst/; You MUSTN'T go. /mʌsn/
    b) Kasseta belgisi: "Listen and tick the sentences with the 'strong form'. Listen again and repeat." 1 You MUST wear boots to go skiing. 2 Yes, you MUST. 3 You MUST have a licence to drive a car. 4 No, you MUSTN'T. 5 You MUSTN'T speak during the exam. 6 You MUSTN'T enter this room.

O'NG USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq 'Writing' va '(a news report)'.
• TO'Q SARIQ ChIZIQLI QUTI: 'When we write a news report we can divide it into three paragraphs. In the FIRST PARAGRAPH, we write a SHORT SUMMARY of the event. We write about WHO was involved, WHAT happened, and WHERE and WHEN it happened. In the SECOND PARAGRAPH, we write a DETAILED DESCRIPTION of what happened. In the LAST PARAGRAPH we write WHAT ACTION HAS BEEN TAKEN. We normally use PAST TENSES in this type of writing. We always give our report an eye-catching TITLE.'
23) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen to the news report and answer the questions.' 1 How old is Ms Jenkins? 2 What's her job? 3 Where was she injured? 4 What attacked her? 5 Who saved her? 6 Where was she taken?
24) 'Read the notes. In pairs, ask and answer questions using WHO, WHERE, WHEN and WHAT, as in the example.' Qaydlar: • 35-year-old British photographer, Carolyn Jenkins • on safari in South Africa last week • 2 guides and 3 students from the University of Kent • approach lion in jeep • leave jeep to take pictures - get close - lion attack • guides scare the lion away - take her to hospital • South African Tourist Board - warn tourists not to approach wild animals while on safari. Ko'k qiya: SA: Who is Carolyn Jenkins? SB: A 35-year-old British photographer.
25) 'Use the notes from Ex. 24, as well as the plan below, to write a news report about Carolyn Jenkins. Use the texts in Ex. 18 as models.' DAFTAR: Plan - SAVED FROM LION'S JAWS. Introduction: Para 1: who/what/where/when. Main Body: Para 2: detailed description of the event. Conclusion: Para 3: action taken.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Words of Wisdom'. 'Read these sentences. What do they mean?' To'q sariq chiziqli quti: • It is best to be on the safe side. • Better safe than sorry. • Once bitten, twice shy.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '75'.

exercises.instructionEn: What would you say to: a young child playing near a pond? a teenager going skiing? a man going bird-watching near a beach? Give advice, as in the example, using must or mustn't.
exercises.instructionUz: Nima der edingiz: hovuz yonida o'ynayotgan bolaga? chang'i uchishga ketayotgan o'smirga? plyaj yonida qush kuzatishga ketayotgan erkakka? must yoki mustn't bilan maslahat bering, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  "You mustn't play near the pond."


⚠ 74-BETDAGI UCh XABARGA BOG'LIQ:

  hovuz → A xabari (Pamela)
  chang'i → C xabari (Robert)
  qush kuzatish plyajda → B xabari
     (Marcus - qush tuxumi)


⚠ 'BIRD-WATCHING':

  = qush kuzatish (hobbi).
  ⚠ 'to go bird-watching'.


⚠ 'A TEENAGER':

  = o'smir (13-19 yosh).
exercises.exampleEn: You mustn't play near the pond.
modelAnswers: You mustn't play near the pond. You must stay away from the water.
You mustn't ski alone. You must stay on the main slopes.
You mustn't climb the cliffs. You must be careful near the rocks.
modelAnswersUz: Hovuz yonida o'ynamasliging shart. Suvdan uzoq turishing shart.
Yolg'iz chang'i uchmasliging shart. Asosiy qiyaliklarda qolishing shart.
Qoyalarga chiqmasligingiz shart. Qoyalar yonida ehtiyot bo'lishingiz shart.

exercises.explanationUz:
ROZI BO'LISh - 'SO DO I' va
'NEITHER DO I'.


DIALOG:
  A: Tomorrow, I have to wash the
     car.
  B: So do I, but I don't have to do
     the gardening tomorrow.
  A: Neither do I.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  SO DO I = MEN HAM (tasdiqqa)    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'I have to wash the car.' -
  'SO DO I.'
  ⚠ Tartib: So + yordamchi + ega.
  ⚠ 'I have to' → 'So DO I' (oddiy
  fe'l → 'do').


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  NEITHER DO I = MEN HAM (inkorga)║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  "I don't have to do the
   gardening." - 'NEITHER DO I.'
  ⚠ 'neither' o'qilishi /ˈnaɪðə/
  yoki /ˈniːðə/ - ikkalasi to'g'ri.


⚠ BOShQA YoRDAMChILAR:

  'I am tired.' - 'So AM I.'
  'I can swim.' - 'So CAN I.'
  "I can't swim." - 'Neither CAN I.'
  'I went home.' - 'So DID I.'
  "I haven't seen it." - 'Neither
   HAVE I.'


⚠ XATO:

  'Me too' - so'zlashuvda bo'ladi,
  lekin 'So do I' to'g'riroq.
  'I also' - XATO!

sentences.en: A: Tomorrow, I have to wash the car.
B: So do I, but I don't have to do the gardening tomorrow.
sentences.uz: B: Men ham, lekin ertaga bog'da ishlashim shart emas.

exercises.instructionEn: Then use the prompts to act out similar dialogues in pairs.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib juftlikda shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'RSATMALAR: wash the car, do the
gardening, fix the fence, paint the
living room, clean the house, tidy
the garage


⚠ QOLIP:

  A: Tomorrow, I have to [ish 1].
  B: So do I, but I don't have to
     [ish 2] tomorrow.
  A: Neither do I.


⚠ 'TO FIX':

  = tuzatmoq.
  ⚠ 'fix the fence' = panjarani
  tuzatmoq.


⚠ 'A GARAGE':

  = garaj.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈɡærɑːʒ/ (Britaniya).

exercises.instructionEn: In teams, make sentences using words/phrases from the list. Each correct sentence gets one point.
exercises.instructionUz: Jamoalarda ro'yxatdagi so'z va iboralardan gap tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap bir ochko oladi.

modelSentences.sentence: The Coastguard has put up signs on the beach.
modelSentences.uz: Qirg'oq qo'riqlash xizmati plyajga belgilar o'rnatdi.  (belgilar o'rnatmoq)

modelSentences.sentence: Keep all cleaning products in a safe place.
modelSentences.uz: Barcha tozalash vositalarini xavfsiz joyda saqlang.  (tozalash vositalari)

modelSentences.sentence: Children might fall into the pond and drown.
Don't let young children play alone near water.
modelSentences.uz: Yosh bolalarni suv yonida yolg'iz o'ynashga qo'ymang.  (yolg'iz o'ynamoq)

modelSentences.sentence: Robert was trapped in a deep snowdrift.
modelSentences.uz: Robert chuqur qor uyumida qamalib qoldi.  (qamalib qoldi)

modelSentences.sentence: Mr Hirst was taken to hospital in a Coastguard helicopter.
modelSentences.uz: Janob Hirst qirg'oq qo'riqlash xizmati vertolyotida kasalxonaga olib borildi.  (qirg'oq qo'riqlash xizmati)

modelSentences.sentence: The Mountain Rescue Service released a statement to the press.
modelSentences.uz: Tog' qutqaruv xizmati matbuotga bayonot berdi.  (bayonot bermoq)

modelSentences.sentence: Children could get an electric shock from the sockets.
modelSentences.uz: Bolalarni rozetkadan tok urishi mumkin.  (tok urishi)

modelSentences.sentence: Always put sharp objects away after use.
modelSentences.uz: O'tkir narsalarni ishlatgandan keyin har doim joyiga qo'ying.  (o'tkir narsalar)

exercises.instructionEn: We don't always use the 'strong form' of must/mustn't in sentences. Listen and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarda must/mustn't ning 'kuchli shakli' har doim ishlatilmaydi. Tinglang va takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
'MUST' NING KUChLI VA ZAIF ShAKLI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  KUChLI ShAKL (strong form)      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  must /mʌst/, mustn't /mʌsnt/
  ⚠ Gap OXIRIDA yoki URG'U bilan:
  'Yes, you MUST.' / 'No, you
   MUSTN'T.'


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ZAIF ShAKL (weak form)          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  must → /məs/ yoki /məst/
  mustn't → /mʌsn/
  ⚠ Gap O'RTASIDA, keyingi so'z
  bilan qo'shilib:
  'You must do your best.' /məs/
  'You must always try hard.' /məst/
  "You mustn't go." /mʌsn/


⚠ QOIDA:

  Modal fe'l gap O'RTASIDA - ZAIF,
  gap OXIRIDA - KUChLI.
  ⚠ 'can' ham shunday: /kən/ va
  /kæn/.


⚠ /ə/ - SCHWA:

  Eng qisqa, neytral unli.
  Urg'usiz bo'g'inlarda.

sentences.uz: Har doim qattiq harakat qilishing kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and tick the sentences with the 'strong form'. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va 'kuchli shakl' bo'lgan gaplarni belgilang. Yana tinglab takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ Audio bor; qoida bo'yicha:

  KUChLI (gap OXIRIDA):
    2 'Yes, you MUST.' ✓
    4 "No, you MUSTN'T." ✓

  ZAIF (gap O'RTASIDA):
    1 'You must wear boots ...'
    3 'You must have a licence ...'
    5 "You mustn't speak ..."
    6 "You mustn't enter ..."


⚠ 'A LICENCE':

  = guvohnoma, litsenziya.
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'licence' (ot),
  'license' (fe'l); AQShda ikkalasi
  'license'.
  ⚠ 'a driving licence' = haydovchilik
  guvohnomasi.

items.textEn: 1 You must wear boots to go skiing.
3 You must have a licence to drive a car.
5 You mustn't speak during the exam.

exercises.instructionEn: When we write a news report we can divide it into three paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Yangilik xabarini yozganda uni uch xatboshiga bo'lishimiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
YaNGILIK XABARI - QOIDA.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  UCh XATBOShI                    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1) QISQAChA: kim, nima, qayerda,
     qachon (bir-ikki gap)
  2) BATAFSIL tavsif
  3) KO'RILGAN ChORA


⚠ ZAMONLAR:

  PAST TENSES (past simple, past
  continuous); chora uchun present
  perfect ('has put up').


⚠ SARLAVHA (TITLE):

  ⚠ 'eye-catching' = diqqatni
  tortadigan.
  ⚠ Qisqa, artiklsiz, ko'pincha
  majhul: 'CHILD SAVED FROM
  DROWNING'.


⚠ 74-BETDAGI UCh XABAR - NAMUNA.

points.en: In the first paragraph, we write a short summary of the event. We write about who was involved, what happened, and where and when it happened.
points.uz: Birinchi xatboshida voqeaning qisqacha mazmunini yozamiz. Kim ishtirok etgani, nima bo'lgani, qayerda va qachon bo'lgani haqida yozamiz.

points.en: In the second paragraph, we write a detailed description of what happened.
points.uz: Ikkinchi xatboshida nima bo'lganining batafsil tavsifini yozamiz.

points.en: In the last paragraph we write what action has been taken.
points.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida qanday chora ko'rilganini yozamiz.

points.en: We normally use past tenses in this type of writing. We always give our report an eye-catching title.
points.uz: Bunday yozuvda odatda o'tgan zamonlarni ishlatamiz. Xabarimizga har doim diqqatni tortadigan sarlavha beramiz.

QAYDLARIDA:

  1 35 yoshda

  3 Janubiy Afrikada, safarida
  4 sher
  5 gidlar
  6 kasalxonaga


⚠ 'MS':

⚠ 'TO ATTACK':

items.answerEn: She was injured on safari in South Africa.
The guides saved her - they scared the lion away.
items.answerUz: Uni gidlar qutqardi - ular sherni qo'rqitib haydashdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the notes. In pairs, ask and answer questions using who, where, when and what, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Qaydlarni o'qing. Juftlikda who, where, when va what bilan savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
QAYDLAR:

  • 35-year-old British photographer,
    Carolyn Jenkins
  • on safari in South Africa last
    week
  • 2 guides and 3 students from the
    University of Kent
  • approach lion in jeep
  • leave jeep to take pictures -
    get close - lion attack
  • guides scare the lion away -
    take her to hospital
  • South African Tourist Board -
    warn tourists not to approach
    wild animals while on safari

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: Who is Carolyn Jenkins?
  SB: A 35-year-old British
      photographer.


⚠ 'ON SAFARI':

  = safarida (Afrikada yovvoyi
  hayvonlarni ko'rish sayohati).
  ⚠ ARTIKLSIZ: 'on safari'.


⚠ 'TO APPROACH':

  = yaqinlashmoq (PREDLOGSIZ).


⚠ 'TO SCARE AWAY':

  = qo'rqitib haydamoq.


⚠ 'A TOURIST BOARD':

  = turizm boshqarmasi.

items.question: SA: Where and when did the accident happen?
items.answer: SB: On safari in South Africa last week.

items.question: SA: Who was she with?
items.answer: SB: She was with two guides and three students from the University of Kent.

items.question: SA: What happened?
items.answer: SB: They approached a lion in a jeep. She left the jeep to take pictures and got too close, and the lion attacked her.

items.question: SA: Who saved her?
items.answer: SB: The guides scared the lion away and took her to hospital.

items.question: SA: What action has been taken?
items.answer: SB: The South African Tourist Board has warned tourists not to approach wild animals while on safari.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the notes from Ex. 24, as well as the plan below, to write a news report about Carolyn Jenkins. Use the texts in Ex. 18 as models.
exercises.instructionUz: 24-mashqdagi qaydlar va quyidagi rejadan foydalanib Carolyn Jenkins haqida yangilik xabari yozing. 18-mashqdagi matnlardan namuna sifatida foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
REJA - SAVED FROM LION'S JAWS:

  Introduction
    Para 1: who/what/where/when
  Main Body
    Para 2: detailed description of
    the event
  Conclusion
    Para 3: action taken


⚠ 'JAWS':

  = jag'lar.
  ⚠ 'saved from the lion's jaws' =
  sher og'zidan qutqarildi.


⚠ 74-BETDAGI XABARLAR QOLIPI.

structure.exampleEn: 35-year-old British photographer Carolyn Jenkins was injured when a lion attacked her while she was on safari in South Africa last week.

structure.hintUz: gidlar, talabalar, jip, suratlar, hujum, qutqarish
structure.exampleEn: Ms Jenkins was on safari with two guides and three students from the University of Kent when they approached a lion in their jeep. She left the jeep to take pictures of the animal, but she got too close and the lion attacked her. Fortunately, the guides managed to scare the lion away and took her to hospital.
Since the accident, the South African Tourist Board has warned tourists not to approach wild animals while they are on safari.

modelAnswers: 35-year-old British photographer Carolyn Jenkins was injured when a lion attacked her while she was on safari in South Africa last week.

Ms Jenkins was on safari with two guides and three students from the University of Kent when they approached a lion in their jeep. She left the jeep to take pictures of the animal, but she got too close and the lion attacked her. Fortunately, the guides managed to scare the lion away and took her to hospital.
Since the accident, the South African Tourist Board has warned tourists not to approach wild animals while they are on safari.
modelAnswersUz: 35 yoshli britaniyalik fotograf Carolyn Jenkins o'tgan hafta Janubiy Afrikada safarida bo'lganida sher hujumidan jarohatlandi.

Jenkins xonim ikki gid va Kent universitetidan uch talaba bilan safarida edi, ular jipda sherga yaqinlashdi. U hayvonni suratga olish uchun jipdan tushdi, lekin juda yaqin bordi va sher unga hujum qildi. Baxtiga, gidlar sherni qo'rqitib haydashga muvaffaq bo'lishdi va uni kasalxonaga olib borishdi.
Hodisadan beri Janubiy Afrika turizm boshqarmasi turistlarni safarida yovvoyi hayvonlarga yaqinlashmaslikka ogohlantirdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh MAQOL - EhTIYoTKORLIK HAQIDA.

⚠ 'ON THE SAFE SIDE':
  = xavfsiz tomonda, ehtiyotkor.

⚠ 'BETTER SAFE THAN SORRY':
  = afsuslangandan ko'ra ehtiyot
  bo'lgan yaxshi.
  ⚠ Juda keng tarqalgan.

⚠ 'ONCE BITTEN, TWICE SHY':
  = bir marta tishlangan - ikki
  marta ehtiyotkor.
  ⚠ 'shy' bu yerda = ehtiyotkor,
  qo'rqadigan.

items.en: It is best to be on the safe side.
items.answerEn: It means that it is better to be careful than to take risks.
items.answerUz: Ya'ni tavakkal qilgandan ko'ra ehtiyot bo'lgan yaxshi.

items.answerEn: It means that you should take precautions now so that you don't regret it later.
items.answerUz: Ya'ni keyin afsuslanmaslik uchun hozir ehtiyot chorasini ko'rish kerak. (O'zbekchada: 'Ehtiyot - yarim davlat'.)

items.uz: Bir marta tishlangan - ikki marta ehtiyotkor.
items.answerEn: It means that after a bad experience, you are more careful the next time.
items.answerUz: Ya'ni yomon tajribadan keyin keyingi safar ehtiyotkorroq bo'lasan. (O'zbekchada: 'Sutdan og'zi kuygan qatiqni puflab ichadi'.)

patterns.formula: I have to ... - So do I. / I don't have to ... - Neither do I.
patterns.exampleEn: I have to wash the car. - So do I. I don't have to do the gardening. - Neither do I.
patterns.exampleUz: Mashina yuvishim kerak. - Men ham. Bog'da ishlashim shart emas. - Men ham.

patterns.formula: [Kim] was injured when [nima] attacked [kim] while [kim] was [qayerda].
patterns.exampleEn: Carolyn Jenkins was injured when a lion attacked her while she was on safari.
patterns.exampleUz: Carolyn Jenkins safarida bo'lganida sher hujumidan jarohatlandi.

patterns.exampleEn: The Tourist Board has warned tourists not to approach wild animals.
patterns.exampleUz: Turizm boshqarmasi turistlarni yovvoyi hayvonlarga yaqinlashmaslikka ogohlantirdi.
